items.t: Dell, Super Micro Under Pressure as Nvidia Halts Shipments to 4 Asian Countries
items.sum: Server orders bound for four Southeast Asian countries are reportedly stuck, and a new U.S. export rule has a 90-day clock running. Which AI server maker has the room to wait out the delay, and which one does not?

items.t: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Faces Southeast Asia AI Server Disruption After Export Halt
items.sum: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) faces supply disruption after Nvidia suspended advanced AI server shipments to Southeast Asia under new US export controls. The pause affects Nvidia's high end AI chips used in Supermicro systems that target large scale AI data center deployments in the region. items.t: Former Nvidia Executive’s Marriage to Super Micro Leader Adds New Scrutiny to Alleged China Chip-Supply Ties: Report
items.sum: Former Nvidia executive Jay Puri married Super Micro growth chief Cenly Chen as the companies competed for AI chip supplies, report says.

items.t: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Stock Looks Reasonable After A Sharp Pullback
items.sum: Super Micro Computer has swung from a very large 5 year gain to a sharp pullback over the past year. This puts the spotlight squarely on whether the current share price is still in line with what its earnings can support. items.sum: As NVIDIA reignites Wall Street's rally, Arrow Electronics, Super Micro Computer, BP and Ingram Micro stand out as PEG-based value stocks with growth potential.

items.t: Super Micro Falls 7% Despite Dell’s Record AI Server Backlog; Dell Drops 7% as Barclays Cuts Target to $344, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Slides 4%
items.sum: Dell posted a blowout quarter and a backlog its executives call rock solid, yet AI server stocks still sold off. One of the three big names has a weakness the other two avoid, and it explains why the bears are circling.
